name: SurGlane
source:
SurGlane is a city plagued by strange incidents and suspicious suicides. The phenomena have become so frequent that people now call it a cursed city. Journalist George Larson travels to Europe in hopes of escaping unwanted attention back in the United States, choosing to investigate the city’s reputation as a distraction. At the same time, psychotherapist Jürgen Weber arrives to visit an old friend.
Does the supernatural truly exist? Is the city genuinely cursed, or is someone deliberately bringing that curse upon it through their own actions? Losing your mind here is easier than anyone could imagine. And soon, the question is no longer what is happening to the city — but what is happening to you.
